items.a: Most checkups take 30 minutes. A cleaning adds about 20 minutes, and the clinic tells you the expected time when you book.
items.q: How long does a checkup take?

items.a: Yes. Tell the team when you book and they will plan extra time, explain each step and offer breaks.
items.q: I am nervous about the dentist. Can you help?

items.a: Yes. The clinic offers payment plans for larger treatments such as implants and braces. Ask at reception for the options.
Call the clinic as early as you can. Same day slots are kept open for tooth pain, and the team will advise you until your visit.
items.q: What if I have tooth pain today?

items.a: Yes. Children are welcome from age three, and the first visit is a gentle introduction with no treatment unless needed.
Prices are confirmed in writing before treatment starts. A checkup price is confirmed when you book. Demo checkup price: EGP 200.
items.q: How much does a visit cost?

items.a: Yes. The clinic accepts most major insurance plans. Bring your card and reception will check your cover.
You can cancel or move your booking up to 3 hours before the visit, by phone or from your booking confirmation.
items.q: Can I cancel or move my booking?
